name: prompt-327
image_vibe: Quiet glamour with black velvet, ivory marble, warm peach makeup, and autumn floral accents
image_purpose: Create a high-end beauty editorial portrait for lookbook or campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A 4:5 hyper-realistic luxury portrait of an original adult East Asian woman seated at a white marble vanity.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with long sleek dark-brown hair parted in the middle, luminous natural warm skin, soft peach makeup with light eyelid shimmer, subtle eyeliner, coral lipstick, and a confident poised expression. She wears an off-shoulder black velvet dress, a delicate silver pendant necklace, matching silver earrings, and a ring.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject seated gracefully at a white marble vanity table, one arm resting on the marble and the other relaxed by her side, mirror reflecting part of her silhouette, makeup compact, decorative brush, and foundation bottles neatly placed beside her. Use deep navy or dark curtains, white vases, and dried flowers in orange, cream, and gold behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Balanced diffused soft lighting with clean luxury shadows and no harsh highlights, warm peach and soft-gold accents against ivory, black velvet, and navy, quietly glamorous beauty-editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Portrait 4:5 composition, crisp modern-camera look, 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture and velvet, marble, metal, glass, makeup, and dried-flower detail, subtle film grain, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 luxury beauty editorial portrait of an original adult East Asian woman seated gracefully at a white marble vanity table. Give her long sleek dark-brown hair parted in the middle, luminous natural warm skin, soft peach makeup with light eyelid shimmer, subtle eyeliner, coral lipstick, and a confident poised expression. Dress her in an elegant off-shoulder black velvet dress with a delicate silver pendant necklace, matching silver earrings, and a ring. Rest one arm naturally on the marble and the other by her side. Include a mirror reflecting part of her silhouette, a compact palette, a small decorative brush, and foundation bottles on the vanity. Set deep navy or dark curtains and minimalist decor behind her, with white vases filled with dried flowers in warm orange, cream, and gold. Use balanced diffused soft lighting, clean luxury shadows, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, velvet, marble, metal, glass, makeup, and flower texture, subtle film grain, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed jewelry, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh highlights, watermark, text

assets.name: source black velvet vanity portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for black velvet dress, white marble vanity, mirror, makeup props, dark curtains, dried flowers, and warm luxury palette; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult East Asian fashion subject, black velvet outfit, vanity composition, makeup props, mirror, dark curtains, dried flowers, and quiet glamour. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified 'young' wording as an original adult subject while retaining the source's beauty-editorial styling.
